values: 召唤风暴，对风暴内的敌人持续造成伤害并降低急速。
Lorsan summons a storm, dealing continuous damage to enemies within its range and reducing their Haste.
选择最靠前的1名敌人持续施法，在其所在位置及周围2格生成持续5秒的风暴，风暴范围内的敌人降低30 + 3点急速，并每0.5秒受到洛桑50% + 6% ATK的伤害。

Lorsan channels his power to summon a storm centered on the frontmost enemy, lasting for 5s. Enemies within 2 tiles of the target are affected by the storm, suffering a 30 + 3 Haste reduction and taking 50% + 6% ATK damage from Lorsan every 0.5s.
每次对敌人造成的伤害提升至55% + 6% ATK。
Increases the storm damage per hit to 55% + 6% ATK.
每次对敌人造成的伤害提升至60% + 6% ATK。
Increases the storm damage per hit to 60% + 6% ATK.
每次对敌人造成的伤害提升至65% + 6% ATK。
Increases the storm damage per hit to 65% + 6% ATK.
每次对敌人造成的伤害提升至70% + 6% ATK。
Increases the storm damage per hit to 70% + 6% ATK.
战斗开始后，用“风链”连接最近和最远的敌人，传递伤害。
When a battle starts, Lorsan links the nearest and farthest enemy heroes to each other with Stormbound Chain.
战斗开始后，用“风链”连接距离自己最近和最远的各一名敌方英雄，其中一方受到伤害时，会使另一方也承受本次伤害量的70% + 10%（每名敌人每秒通过该技能受到的伤害不超过洛桑攻击力的500%，且该伤害无法击败敌人）。当这两名敌人通过该技能受到的伤害总和达到洛桑初始攻击力的900%，或其中一名敌人被击败时，“风链”断开。

When a battle starts, Lorsan links the nearest and farthest enemy heroes to each other with Stormbound Chain. The chain transfers 70% + 10% of the damage taken by one of the linked enemies to the other. Damage transferred by the chain cannot exceed 500% of Lorsan's ATK and will not defeat the enemy. The chain breaks when its total damage dealt to both enemies reaches 900% of Lorsan's initial ATK, or if one of the linked enemies is defeated.
另一名敌人受到的伤害提升至伤害量的80% + 10%。
Increases the damage transferred to the linked enemy to 80% + 10% of the original damage.
另一名敌人受到的伤害提升至伤害量的90% + 10%。
Increases the damage transferred to the linked enemy to 90% + 10% of the original damage.
另一名敌人受到的伤害提升至伤害量的100% + 10%。
Increases the damage transferred to the linked enemy to 100% + 10% of the original damage.
为最虚弱的友军持续回复生命值，并提高闪避率和急速。
Lorsan continuously recovers HP for the weakest ally while increasing their dodge chance and Haste.
为最虚弱的友军施加持续6秒的“风愈之护”，在此期间，该友军获得50闪避率和30 + 3点急速，并且每秒回复-90% − 12% ATK的生命值。
Lorsan protects the weakest ally with Zephyr's Embrace for 6s. While active, the protected ally gains 50 dodge chance, 30 + 3 Haste, and recovers -90% − 12% ATK HP per second.
每秒的生命回复量提升至-100% − 12% ATK。
Increases HP recovered per second to -100% − 12% ATK.
每秒的生命回复量提升至-110% − 12% ATK。
Increases HP recovered per second to -110% − 12% ATK.
每秒的生命回复量提升至-120% − 12% ATK。
Increases HP recovered per second to -120% − 12% ATK.
提高自身攻击，风链断开后额外提升自身攻击。
Lorsan increases his ATK in battle. When Stormbound Chain breaks for the first time, his ATK is further increased.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升9%，风链首次断开后额外提升6%攻击力。
Lorsan increases his ATK by 9% during battle. When Stormbound Chain breaks for the first time, Lorsan's ATK is increased by an extra 6%.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升12%，风链首次断开后额外提升8%攻击力。
Lorsan increases his ATK by 12% during battle. When Stormbound Chain breaks for the first time, Lorsan's ATK is increased by an extra 8%.
战斗中，自身的攻击力提升15%，风链首次断开后额外提升10%攻击力。
Lorsan increases his ATK by 15% during battle. When Stormbound Chain breaks for the first time, Lorsan's ATK is increased by an extra 10%.
“风链”断开时，治疗全体友军并再次释放“风链”。
When Stormbound Chain breaks, Lorsan heals all allies then casts Stormbound Chain again.
“风链”断开时，使所有友军回复200% ATK的生命值，并再次释放“风链”。每场战斗最多释放3次风链。
Lorsan recovers 200% ATK of HP for all allies when Stormbound Chain breaks. He will then cast Stormbound Chain again, with a maximum of 3 casts per battle.
“风链”断开时回复的生命值提升至300% ATK。
Increases HP recovered to 300% ATK when Stormbound Chain breaks.
“风链”断开时，使原本被链接的2名敌人晕眩5秒。
Stuns the last linked 2 enemies for 5s when Stormbound Chain breaks.
“风链”断开时回复的生命值提升至400% ATK。
Increases HP recovered to 400% ATK when Stormbound Chain breaks.
“风愈之护”还会使目标处于霸体状态。
Lorsan's Zephyr's Embrace also makes the protected target unaffected.
“风愈之护”还会使目标在持续期间内处于霸体状态
While Zephyr's Embrace is active, the protected target becomes unaffected.
“风链”释放次数增加到5次，风链传导伤害时额外造成传导伤害量20%的生命削减效果。每次风链断裂时，还会对造成伤害最高的友军施加4.5秒的“风愈之护”效果，若该友军身上已有该效果，则使其持续时间延长4.5秒。

Lorsan can cast Stormbound Chain 5 times. Each time Stormbound Chain transfers damage, it also inflicts max HP reduction equal to 20% of the transferred damage. Whenever Stormbound Chain breaks, the ally dealing the most damage gains Zephyr's Embrace for 4.5s. If that ally already has this effect, its duration will be extended by 4.5s.
